beetrooperflysting.name: Beetrooper Fly & Sting
beetrooperflysting.desc: When your opponent activates a monster effect, while you control a "Beetrooper" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY and you control an Insect monster with 3000 or more ATK: You can banish 1 Insect monster from your GY; Set this card. You can only use 1 "Beetrooper Fly & Sting" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

blueeyesultimatedragonthegodsurpassingse.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant
blueeyesultimatedragonthegodsurpassingse.desc:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your opponent's turn. Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase. Once per Chain, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster that was Special Summoned this turn, or 1 face-down card, that your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant" thrice per turn.

burningspear.name: Burning Spear
burningspear.desc: A FIRE monster equipped with this card increases its ATK by 400 points and decreases its DEF by 200 points.

ddwarriorlady.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
ddwarriorlady.desc: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

despairfromthedark.name: Despair from the Dark
despairfromthedark.desc: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

familiarknight.name: Familiar Knight
familiarknight.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from their hand.

houseduston.name: House Duston
houseduston.desc: When this face-up card on the field is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle, and it was face-up at the start of the Damage Step, or by card effect) and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon any "Duston" monsters of your choice from your hand and/or Deck to anywhere on the field, but you must Special Summon an equal number of monsters on each side.

junkmeister.name: Junk Meister
junkmeister.desc: You can reveal 1 "Warrior" or "Stardust" Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Junk" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Junk Meister". You can target 1 "Junk" monster you control; reduce its Level by up to 2. You can only use each effect of "Junk Meister" once per turn.

lyriluscbirdsanctuary.name: Lyrilusc - Bird Sanctuary
lyriluscbirdsanctuary.desc: You can target 2 Winged Beast Xyz Monsters you control; attach 1 of those monsters to the other as material. (Transfer its materials to that monster.) If you control an Xyz Monster with 3 or more materials: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Lyrilusc - Bird Sanctuary" once per turn.

madreloader.name: Mad Reloader
madreloader.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 2 cards.

magiciansrestage.name: Magician's Restage
magiciansrestage.desc: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower Spellcaster-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 "Magician" Continuous Spell Card from your Deck to your hand, except "Magician's Restage".

maleficselector.name: Malefic Selector
maleficselector.desc: Banish 2 "Malefic" cards from your GY; add 2 "Malefic" cards from your Deck to your hand, except "Malefic Selector", with different names from each other and from the banished cards. You can only activate 1 "Malefic Selector" per turn.

mercuriumthelivingquicksilver.name: Mercurium the Living Quicksilver
mercuriumthelivingquicksilver.desc:
2+ Level 10 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can attach 1 monster from your Deck to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Mercurium the Living Quicksilver" once per turn. While this card has material, your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in their GY with the same Attribute as a monster in your GY. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or take 3000 damage.

nordicbeastgullinbursti.name: Nordic Beast Gullinbursti
nordicbeastgullinbursti.desc: For a Synchro Summon, you can substitute this card for any 1 "Nordic" Tuner. You can only use each of the following effects of "Nordic Beast Gullinbursti" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Nordic" monster from your hand. You can target 1 "Nordic" monster in your GY, except "Nordic Beast Gullinbursti"; add it to your hand.

oneeyedshielddragon.name: One-Eyed Shield Dragon
oneeyedshielddragon.desc: This dragon wears a shield not only for its own protection, but also for ramming its enemies.

raidraptorbladeburnerfalcon.name: Raidraptor - Blade Burner Falcon
raidraptorbladeburnerfalcon.desc:
2 Level 4 Winged Beast-Type monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned, and your opponent's LP is at least 3000 higher than yours: You can make this card gain 3000 ATK. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can detach any number of Xyz Materials from this card; destroy exactly that number of monsters your opponent controls.

summonersart.name: Summoner's Art
summonersart.desc: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

symphonicwarriorguitaar.name: Symphonic Warrior Guitaar
symphonicwarriorguitaar.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster from your Deck, except "Symphonic Warrior Guitaar". You can only use this effect of "Symphonic Warrior Guitaar" once per turn.

[ Monster Effect ] 
When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

terrorfromthedeep.name: Terror from the Deep!
terrorfromthedeep.desc: Activate this Skill during your Main Phase, while you control "Kairyu-Shin". When this Skill is activated, you can activate "Umi" directly from your hand, Deck or GY. While you control "Kairyu-Shin", all WATER monsters you control are unaffected by Trap effects. If "Kairyu-Shin" you control leaves the field, draw 2 cards, and if you do, flip this card over.

worldlegacyinshadow.name: World Legacy in Shadow
worldlegacyinshadow.desc: All "Krawler" monsters on the field gain 300 ATK/DEF. Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Insect monster from your hand in face-up or face-down Defense Position. When your Flip monster is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster: You can send that opponent's monster to the GY.
